title: Head of Product - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already integrated in the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Product, you will lead our core app product initiatives locally driving them from zero to one. You’ll work cross-functionally to define and execute on the product roadmap with a focus on growth, retention, and user experience — positioning Luzia as the world’s most loved AI-powered personal assistant.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead team to define the future of Luzia’s product in Brasil and globally.

  • Lead the local strategy, development, and optimization of Luzia’s product with a focus on user growth, retention, and social features.

  • Work closely with engineering and technical leadership to deeply understand and translate technical possibilities and limitations into bold, forward-looking product decisions.

  • Define and drive the product roadmap based on user insights, behavioral data, and business priorities.

  • Guide Engineering, Marketing, and Design teams with local insights to deliver high-quality products quickly and iteratively.

  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, documentation, and scopes for engineering teams.

  • Communicate product vision and updates clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Develop and track key product metrics to evaluate performance, inform decisions, and guide future development.

  • Design and run experiments to test hypotheses, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

  • Operate with agility in a fast-paced environment, embracing ambiguity and driving creative, scalable solutions.

  • Stay on the pulse of AI research and Gen-AI trends, spotting opportunities to infuse Luzia with fresh capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone who’s deeply curious about users, passionate about discovering user needs, and can bring bold ideas to life

  • Deep experience in consumer-facing mobile app development, ideally in high-growth or startup environments.

  • Strong product instincts and a proven ability to make data-informed decisions.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

  • Leadership experience in building and scaling cross-functional product teams.

  • A track record of delivering impactful products in internet- or mobile-first companies.

  • Experience with B2C apps, ideally in messaging, productivity, or AI.

  • Comfort navigating technical conversations with Engineering and AI teams.Strong UX and design sensibilities, with an eye for detail and a passion for intuitive interfaces.

  • Proficiency in product analytics, experimentation, and business intelligence tools.

  • Fluency in English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

Trabalhamos em estreita colaboração com partes interessadas internas/externas, como fornecedores e clientes (internos e externos)

  • Experiência em gestão de indicadores de produção, qualidade e segurança.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Necessários

Ferramentas e Sistemas

· Flexibilidade – Defendemos as interações pessoais e a colaboração presencial associadas a um ambiente de trabalho aberto e flexível, valorizando o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

· Uma cultura próspera - Estamos empenhados em desenvolver uma cultura inclusiva que permita a todos dar o seu melhor e atingir o seu pleno potencial. Uma cultura que é corajosa, convincente e atenciosa, e que nos une para construirmos juntos um futuro sustentável.

· Extensas oportunidades de aprendizagem – Estimulamos diálogos contínuos, sessões de feedback, oportunidades de mobilidade interna, programas de mentoria, treinamento e desenvolvimento, entre outros projetos ambiciosos e oportunidades globais.

· Interação sem fronteiras – Aproveite nossa rede de colegas em todo o mundo para troca de experiências e conhecimento. Realizamos os trabalhos juntos, através de uma comunicação aberta e sincera.

description:
Gerente de RH (foco em sistemas de gestão)

SOBRE A FLUENCYPASS
Na Fluencypass, somos movidos por propósito, guiados por métricas e orientados por uma cultura que coloca o estudante no centro. Valorizamos ações planejadas de forma estratégica e de alto impacto. Buscamos alguém que viva cultura, respire indicadores e construa pontes entre pessoas, processos e decisões estratégicas. Essa é uma vaga para quem enxerga o RH como fonte de dados estratégicos e uma área essencial para o crescimento sustentável da companhia.

Missão da posição

Ser a liderança responsável por consolidar e evoluir a área de Recursos Humanos da Fluencypass, com forte foco em Gestão de RH e Sistemas de Gestão, produzindo indicadores, análises e insights que apoiem diretamente o CEO nas decisões mais estratégicas da empresa. Essa pessoa atuará 50% estratégica e 50% tática, fortalecendo rituais, cultura, processos e a tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência sólida em Gestão de RH e Sistemas de Gestão, capaz de combinar pensamento analítico, visão sistêmica e execução prática. Alguém que atua de forma estratégica, lidera com clareza, toma decisões com responsabilidade, fortalece cultura, comunica com transparência e impulsiona a organização para alta performance. Profissional com domínio de metodologias modernas de gestão (OKRs, Lean, PDCA, Hoshin Kanri, Design Thinking, entre outras), forte capacidade de leitura humana e habilidade para transformar dados em insights acionáveis. Precisa ter vivência em People Analytics, rituais de gestão e implementação de processos que sustentem crescimento, produtividade e cultura organizacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como parceira estratégica do negócio, conectando visão sistêmica, análise crítica e foco em resultados.
  • Desenhar, estruturar e aprimorar processos, políticas e rituais de gestão e cultura da empresa.
  • Liderar People Analytics, implementando indicadores, análises de produtividade, engajamento, clima, turnover, headcount e eficiência operacional.
  • Construir e acompanhar dashboards executivos, relatórios estratégicos e análises preditivas para apoiar a tomada de decisão do CEO e da alta liderança.
  • Realizar desdobramento de metas, planos de ação, gestão à vista e acompanhamento estruturado de resultados em todos os níveis.
  • Implantar ou fortalecer metodologias de gestão (OKRs, Lean Six Sigma, PDCA, SDCA, Hoshin Kanri, Kaizen, etc.) de forma integrada ao dia a dia da operação.
  • Desenvolver iniciativas de Employee Experience, jornada do colaborador, comunicação interna e cultura organizacional.
  • Atuar em programas de engajamento, rituais de reconhecimento, marca empregadora e desenvolvimento de lideranças.
  • Garantir clareza, eficiência e alinhamento cultural nos programas, fluxos e políticas de RH.
  • Realizar gestão da equipe de RH, formando, desenvolvendo e acompanhando novos talentos da área.
  • Conduzir treinamentos, mentorias e iniciativas de gestão para públicos estratégicos, táticos e operacionais.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência como Gerente de RH.
  • Forte domínio de People Analytics (Excel / Google Sheets avançado, BI, dashboards, indicadores).
  • Vivência com metodologias e ferramentas de gestão: OKRs, PDCA / SDCA, Lean Six Sigma, A3, Kaizen, 5W2H.
  • Experiência com clima, engajamento e cultura organizacional.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, cruzamento de dados e construção de narrativas executivas.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação com C-level.
  • Capacidade de atuar com maturidade em contextos de crescimento acelerado.

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America - where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.

R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, J.P. Morgan. We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling our operations across multiple markets.

As an Engineering Manager (EM), you will be responsible for building and nurturing a high-performing engineering team. You’ll balance people leadership, execution management, and technical guidance, ensuring the team delivers high-quality, scalable solutions aligned with product and business goals.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, cares deeply about people, and has the technical depth to support strong decision-making without being hands‑on every day.

Responsibilities

People Management

  • Hire, onboard, and grow engineers across different levels.
  • Run effective 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations.
  • Coach engineers in both technical and soft skills.
  • Foster a healthy, inclusive, and motivating team culture.

Execution Management

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and with quality.
  • Oversee sprint rituals (planning, standups, retrospectives) from a manager’s perspective.
  • Identify and remove blockers, improve workflows, and refine processes.
  • Partner with PMs and Designers to set priorities and align on goals.

Technical Leadership

  • Guide architectural and technical decisions (without daily coding).
  • Ensure best practices in testing, monitoring, scalability, and security.
  • Review designs and mentor senior engineers.
  • Act as a bridge between leadership priorities and engineering execution.

Strategic & Business Alignment

  • Understand product and business goals and translate them into engineering strategy.
  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability.
  • Participate in budgeting and headcount planning.
  • Represent engineering in leadership and cross‑functional discussions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong empathy, emotional intelligence, and communication skills.
  • Experience in coaching, mentorship, and conflict resolution.
  • Ability to create trust and psychological safety.
  • Solid grasp of Agile, Kanban, or Lean practices.
  • Familiarity with prioritization frameworks (OKRs, RICE, ICE).
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders and managing expectations.
  • Proven ability to hire and build great teams.
  • Solid background in software engineering and systems design.
  • Ability to evaluate technical proposals and make informed trade-offs.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure, scalability, observability, and reliability.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, testing practices, and incident response.
  • Ability to connect engineering decisions to business impact.
  • Strong judgment in balancing speed vs. quality, features vs. tech debt.
  • Comfort communicating trade‑offs and risks to executives.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, with 2+ years in management or tech lead roles.
  • Proven experience managing teams of 5–15 engineers.
  • Background in fintech, SaaS, or other high‑scale environments is a plus.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish/Portuguese is a strong plus.
